_comment: Entry 11, Dillon Mulroy's recipe-diagrams layout applied to the view skill at the end of PR #5 (da9a69c). Rows are input streams (target kinds), columns are stages, an action spanning several rows is a join. Same schema as his skill: rows is an inclusive zero-based range. Hand-written from skills/view/SKILL.md.
title: view skill: from a target to a running viewer
yield: one viewer URL, or a reason it can't open
setup: REPO = named worktree or checkout, else the current repo
default branch = git symbolic-ref --short refs/remotes/origin/HEAD (fallback main, master)

actions.label: HEAD = current branch; if it is the default, ask
run as 'nothing' with git -C; detached HEAD = its SHA
HEAD = branch, or origin/branch if only remote
HEAD = sha; root commit: stop, can't be shown
rev-list --count --no-merges BASE..HEAD; 0 = report and stop (offer the PR if merged through one)
npm install (first run); serve --daemon --open; report URL and keys
